description: We are university students from Taiwan and our purpose is let the children know how a space mission is completed and let them have a concept about being an astronaut.
summary: The main aim of our project is to let the upcoming juniors have an image about how a space base is operated. We use an imaginary base on the moon, and used the general data of the space , make it more understandable for the children.
details:
Lunar base is an educational browser game for 7-12 years old children, to let them have a first image about how an astronaut does his missions on the space base and the problems he will meet. We design a movable character with survival states like oxygen ,water and food .The player can move at the moon surface within a limited oxygen.

At first we designed a newbie training to which can be skip .We designed six interactive mini games(examples: relay beacon repair, solar alignment, water purification esc) introducing different astronaut missions and after a mission is complete , we will also provide a knowledge card and a shortcut to NASA data website to let the player know why we need to do these missions and the outcomes. We also add some accident cases that occurs once a day after the training is completed and the player has to make different choices to solve these questions.

The main benefits are making the space knowledge more approachable and understandable for the children through the interactive games .

Luna Base was developed using JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS, with Vite as the development and build tool and Node.js/npm for the development environment. GitHub is used for code sharing and team collaboration. Most of the game actions can be done on a keyboard and required no professional hardware to operate. ChatGPT was used to accomplish the ideas into the game by coding, debugging and assemble the data we need to research and use.

Our creative for the project is exploration on the space base, the resources control , the unpredictable accidents and we provide a guide to solve all these problems , making it is less difficult for the children and i think the most important is we provide a knowledge card and also a link to the NASA data to make the space science more popularization.

We considered the playable of the game, the time to complete a complete game, a score board in the final to let the children to try their best and to simplification of the data so that the children can understand .
